name: Usual USD
oneLiner: USD0 is Usual's RWA-backed dollar, collateralized by tokenized U.S. T-bills and cash-equivalent products such as USYC, M, USTBL, and USDC.

mintAuthority.summary: USD0 issuance runs through Usual's RWA/custody-backed protocol contracts: DaoCollateral and SwapperEngine hold USD0_MINT role on the RegistryAccess contract and mint against eligible collateral; governance controls are two distinct 8-of-15 Gnosis Safes managing role-granting and contract upgrades.

controls.label: Usual DaoCollateral
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294761: RegistryAccess (0x0d374775e962c3608b8f0a4b8b10567df739bb56).hasRole(USD0_MINT role 0xb90c0a1b..., DaoCollateral) returned true. DaoCollateral is an UUPS proxy (implementation 0x0eec861d49f15f585d6bb4301fc4f89bce22af4e, ProxyAdmin 0xc6b60cbcec7d9f98fdcdef6b9a611a955d7fefd4). Minting is bounded by eligible RWA collateral backing requirements in the swap() function.

collateral: Tokenized short-term U.S. Treasury bills and reverse repos, primarily via Hashnote USYC; also M by M0, USTBL by Spiko, and indirect USDC gateway liquidity
pegMechanism: 1:1 minting by depositing approved RWA tokens (e.g. USYC) directly, or depositing USDC via a gateway; redeemable 1:1 for underlying RWA assets via the DaoCollateral contract at any time; arbitrageurs enforce the peg

applicabilityBasis.summary: USD0 is a 1:1 USD-pegged, RWA-backed token redeemable on-chain — token-level characteristics fit "payment stablecoin" under the GENIUS Act. However, the issuer is Usual DAO, a France-domiciled decentralized autonomous organization with no US legal entity. Whether and how the GENIUS Act's issuer-level obligations reach a DAO issuer domiciled in France is genuinely unclear, especially while foreign-issuer comparability rules remain in proposed-rulemaking phase.

genius.notes: USD0 is DAO-issued (Usual DAO holds 100% protocol asset ownership per UIP-15, Dec 2025) with Usual Labs SAS (France) acting as service provider, not issuer. No public GENIUS authorization, state-qualified approval, official application, or foreign-exception registration was located. Applicability marked unclear because GENIUS Act issuer-level obligations on a France-domiciled DAO with no US legal entity remain unresolved while foreign-issuer comparability rulemaking is still at NPRM stage.
